Steggall, 3 June 1826 in London - 7 June 1905 in London); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no96030425 (Steggall, Charles, 1826-1905); https://www.hymnary.org/tune/tabor_steggall (The Believers Hymn Book #78b: 'Charles Steggall (1826-1905)'); CCEH's page gives only the year 1890.
